description: This source file contains the implementation of an immutable placeholder class for entities, specifically used to replace entity-related identifiers within a system. It defines the class ImmutableEntityPlaceholder, including its singleton instance and methods for resolving entity IDs based on provided placeholders.

classes.name: ImmutableEntityPlaceholder
classes.description: An immutable singleton class that provides functionality to resolve entity IDs from placeholders, replacing parts of the entity identification scheme in the system.

methods.name: getPrefix
methods.description: Returns the prefix string associated with this placeholder, which is 'entity'.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Attempts to resolve a given entity ID based on the placeholder provided. It parses the entity ID, verifies its validity, and returns an Optional containing the resolved value if successful.
